# LabelNest

> LabelNest is a data systems and intelligence company based in Bengaluru, India. It builds
> and operates two products: NestLens, a private markets operating system for emerging fund
> managers and analysts, and NestHR, an HR and campus-placement operating system for startups
> and colleges. Founder and Director: Ankit Suman.

## Products

- [NestLens](https://labelnest.in/nestlens): Private markets OS with three modules —
  Intelligence (tracks 40,000+ entities: companies, funds, GPs, LPs, deals, service providers),
  Exchange (marketplace for buying/selling verified structured private-markets data, KYC-verified
  sellers), and Capital Readiness (investor-ready data room builder, LP-GP matching). Credit-based
  access, no lock-in. Live at nestlens.labelnest.in.
- [NestLens vs Preqin](https://labelnest.in/vs/preqin)
- [NestLens vs PitchBook](https://labelnest.in/vs/pitchbook)
- [NestLens vs DocSend](https://labelnest.in/vs/docsend)
- [NestLens vs Carta](https://labelnest.in/vs/carta)
- [NestHR](https://labelnest.in/nesthr): HR and placement OS with 7 modules — People, Talent OS /
  PlacementOS (its flagship module, built for campus recruitment and startup hiring, improves
  shortlisting accuracy from every selection/rejection signal), Performance, Expense, Learning,
  Analytics, Admin. INR pricing, built for India. Live at nesthr.labelnest.in.

- [LabelNest Ecosystem](https://labelnest.in/ecosystem): how NestLens, NestHR, and Managed
